hooks.name: Session Continuity Check
hooks.description: When an agent saves a session log, check it against the campaign bible's continuity rules, safety and house rules, and confirm state.json was updated. Judgment-level check; the deterministic part is campaign-validate.json.

action.prompt: A session log was just saved. Find its campaign folder (the folder containing sessions/). Read that campaign's BIBLE.md (Safety, House Rules, Continuity Rules, Canon Forks) and state.json. Check the saved log: every continuity rule (PASS/FAIL), dead NPCs did not act, every change under '## State Changes' is reflected in state.json, rulings are logged, new canon is recorded under '## Canon Added' or the bible, and nothing crossed a line or veil. Report a PASS/FAIL table with a fix for each FAIL. Do not edit files unless the user asks.
